item.title: DevPulse 0.11.0
item.description:
• Settings › GitHub › Repositories: list the repositories (owner/name, or a pasted GitHub address) in which the quick launcher looks up a bare number and gh <number>; it shows a row for each of them with the pull request's title and state. It replaces the single default repository, and your earlier choice is kept as the first entry.
  • gh <name> <number> also knows the repositories from that list by their name.
  • The quick launcher asks GitHub about all those pull requests in one request.
